text: And it came to pass in the days{H3117} when the judges{H8199} judged,{H8199} that there was a famine{H7458} in the land.{H776} And a certain man{H376} of Beth-lehem-judah{H1035} went{H3212} to sojourn{H1481} in the country{H7704} of Moab,{H4124} he, and his wife,{H802} and his two{H8147} sons.{H1121}

Jehovah{H3068} grant{H5414} you that ye may find{H4672} rest,{H4496} each{H802} of you in the house{H1004} of her husband.{H376} Then she kissed{H5401} them, and they lifted up{H5375} their voice,{H6963} and wept.{H1058}
And they said{H559} unto her, Nay, but we will return{H7725} with thee unto thy people.{H5971}
And Naomi{H5281} said,{H559} Turn again,{H7725} my daughters:{H1323} why will ye go{H3212} with me? have I yet sons{H1121} in my womb,{H4578} that they may be your husbands?{H582}

Turn again,{H7725} my daughters,{H1323} go{H3212} your way; for I am too old{H2204} to have a husband.{H376} If I should say,{H559} I have{H3426} hope,{H8615} if I should even have a husband{H376} to-night,{H3915} and should also bear{H3205} sons;{H1121}

would ye therefore tarry{H7663} till they{H3860} were grown?{H1431} would ye therefore stay{H5702} from having{H3860} husbands?{H376} nay, my daughters,{H1323} for it grieveth{H4843} me much{H3966} for your sakes, for the hand{H3027} of Jehovah{H3068} is gone forth{H3318} against me.
And they lifted up{H5375} their voice,{H6963} and wept again:{H1058} and Orpah{H6204} kissed{H5401} her mother-in-law,{H2545} but Ruth{H7327} clave{H1692} unto her.
And she said,{H559} Behold, thy sister-in-law{H2994} is gone back{H7725} unto her people,{H5971} and unto her god:{H430} return{H7725} thou after{H310} thy sister-in-law.{H2994}

And Ruth{H7327} said,{H559} Entreat{H6293} me not to leave{H5800} thee, and to return{H7725} from following after{H310} thee, for whither thou goest,{H3212} I will go;{H3212} and where thou lodgest,{H3885} I will lodge;{H3885} thy people{H5971} shall be my people,{H5971} and thy God{H430} my God;{H430}
where thou diest,{H4191} will I die,{H4191} and there will I be buried:{H6912} Jehovah{H3068} do{H6213} so to me, and more{H3254} also, if aught but death{H4194} part{H6504} thee and me.
And when she saw{H7200} that she was stedfastly minded{H553} to go{H3212} with her, she left{H2308} off speaking{H1696} unto her.

So they two{H8147} went{H3212} until they came{H935} to Beth-lehem.{H1035} And it came to pass, when they were come{H935} to Beth-lehem,{H1035} that all the city{H5892} was moved{H1949} about them, and [the women] said,{H559} Is this Naomi?{H5281}
And she said{H559} unto them, Call{H7121} me not Naomi,{H5281} call{H7121} me Mara;{H4755} for the Almighty{H7706} hath dealt very{H3966} bitterly{H4843} with me.

I went out{H1980} full,{H4392} and Jehovah{H3068} hath brought me home again{H7725} empty;{H7387} why call{H7121} ye me Naomi,{H5281} seeing Jehovah{H3068} hath testified{H6030} against me, and the Almighty{H7706} hath afflicted{H7489} me?
